hints.title: Decision State Representation
hints.text: At each position j along the floor, you can either leave the tile uncovered or place the end of a carpet covering up to carpetLen tiles.

hints.title: Dynamic Programming Recurrence
hints.text: Let dp[i][j] denote the minimum white tiles visible in floor[0..j-1] using at most i carpets.

hints.title: 2D DP Table Implementation

complexity.notes: Each DP cell evaluates two O(1) transitions.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Greedy choice fails because overlapping or shifting carpets changes future optimal placements.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Can be space-optimized to O(n) using rolling rows.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate formulates 2D knapsack-style DP over carpets and floor prefixes.
